items.period: Shang oracle-bone script form; associated source labeled 合822正
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw sourced to Xiaoxuetang
items.caption: Modern redraw of the Shang oracle-bone form 身 catalogued as 合822正; early graph interpretations differ over whether its marked abdomen indicates the body/abdomen or pregnancy.
items.alt: Black vector outline representing the oracle-bone form 身, identified by Commons as the 合822正 form.
items.selection_reason: Shows the earliest cited graphic stage and links to a specific catalogued form while keeping the competing readings open.
items.rights: Commons description states CC0 1.0 for the Xiaoxuetang-derived picture and public-domain reuse for the vector representation.

items.period: Small-seal script as represented in the Shuowen tradition
items.caption: Modern redraw of 身 in Shuowen seal-script style, a later standardized form in the graph's documented history.
items.alt: Black vector outline of 身 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Offers a later script-stage comparison to the oracle-bone redraw; it is an illustration of a documented script style, not an artifact image.
items.rights: Commons marks the vector representation as public domain.

limitations.text: Neither candidate is an ancient artifact photograph; both are modern vector redrawings. The early figure's exact intended referent remains disputed by the consulted paleographic sources.
